crossRefs.note: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

parallels.note: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

translations.web: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
translations.bsb: So from then on Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
translations.kjv: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
translations.asv: And from that time he sought opportunity to deliver him unto them.
